issue.title: Recursive custom syntax definition can crash MacOS due to OOM

llm_context.input_title: Recursive custom syntax definition can crash MacOS due to OOM
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: A recursive custom syntax definition can cause unbounded memory allocation, leading to a kernel panic on MacOS.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The issue occurs when a custom syntax definition includes a scope that collides with the scope it is trying to include, causing an infinite loop of memory allocation.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Custom syntax definitions are used to define the syntax of a programming language.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Custom syntax definitions are important for highlighting and formatting code.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The issue occurs due to a recursive custom syntax definition.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Scope collisions occur when two or more scopes have the same name.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Scope collisions can cause issues with code highlighting and formatting.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The issue occurs due to a scope collision in the custom syntax definition.
